# Minjia Fu

I am a PhD student in Economics at ENS de Lyon, affiliated with CERGIC, under the supervision of Florence Goffette-Nagot.

My research interests lie in economic geography, spatial inequality, and urban economics. I am particularly interested in how changes in infrastructure and connectivity affect the distribution of economic opportunities across places and populations.

::: {.question-block}
## Questions that motivate my work

Who benefits from changes in connectivity, and who becomes worse off? How do they affect where people choose to live, their access to labour markets, and the development of cities and regions?
